card.text: A Cepheid in the Triangulum Galaxy, 840 kiloparsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 15.8 days.

sources.label: Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951 118 2023
sources.locator: table 9, ID 01340166+3031030: logP; Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 118: mu

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope measured its brightness in three colors; its pulsation takes 15.8 days. Its galaxy's distance, 840 kiloparsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.

sources.label: Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951 118 2023
